name: Carla D. Dillon
office: Crescenta Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Carla D. Dillon is the director of Engineering & Operations for the Crescenta Valley Water District. She presented the district’s Wastewater Master Plan and a water main replacement project on Montrose Avenue and Foothill Boulevard. She requested up to $32,700 for grant application support services for a federal drought response program.

items.organization: Frank Colcord, Director, Foothill Municipal Water District (Division 5)
